activities.description: Scientist Woman appears and the hand writes "IMIDAZOLE".
The hand writes the molecular formula "C3H4N2" and a 3D model of the molecule appears.
The hand draws a set of scales representing IUPAC and writes "1H-IMIDAZOLE" as the IUPAC name. Then it draws the chemical structure of 1H-Imidazole.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The focus on the structure and IUPAC name suggests the video will delve deeper into its chemical properties.
